name: S.S. Francis R. Scobee
about: S.S. Francis R. Scobee (2024-139A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2024 Aug  4. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Aug  4), held fixed
docked to A06499; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
